title: lobelia assurgens subsp. santa-clarae
intro: Lobelia assurgens subsp. santa-clarae, commonly known as Lobelia, is a plant species native to the Americas. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which help to relieve muscle spasms and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia include alkaloids like lobeline and lobelanine, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity and interactions with other medications.
